name: @zkorum/agora-load-testing
description: k6 load testing suite for Agora voting system

scripts.test:conversation-voting: node ../../scripts/dev-log-runner.mjs --service load-testing -- bash -c 'cd services/load-testing && k6 run --summary-export "$AGORA_LOG_SUMMARY_FILE" dist/scenario1-single-conversation.cjs'
scripts.test:solidago-ranking: node ../../scripts/dev-log-runner.mjs --service load-testing-solidago -- bash -c 'cd services/load-testing && k6 run --summary-export "$AGORA_LOG_SUMMARY_FILE" dist/scenario2-solidago-ranking.cjs'
scripts.test:conversation-voting:build: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:conversation-voting
scripts.test:solidago-ranking:build: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:solidago-ranking
